court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.text: United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Motion to designate “The WGAR Broadcasting Company” as a party respondent granted. Certiorari denied.

attorneys: Paul M. Segal, Philip J. Hennessey, Jr. and Harry P. Warner for petitioner.

Solicitor General Perlman, Benedict P. Cottone, Max Goldman and Richard A. Solomon for the Federal Communications Commission; and Louis G. Caldwell, Donald C. Beelar and Percy H. Russell, Jr. for the WGAR Broadcasting Co., respondents.
casebody.head_matter:
No. 232.
Simmons v. Federal Communications Commission.
Paul M. Segal, Philip J. Hennessey, Jr. and Harry P. Warner for petitioner.
Solicitor General Perlman, Benedict P. Cottone, Max Goldman and Richard A. Solomon for the Federal Communications Commission; and Louis G. Caldwell, Donald C. Beelar and Percy H. Russell, Jr. for the WGAR Broadcasting Co., respondents.
